ctx.x: There's also a version of it on a Savoy record which has Milt Jackson and Frank Wess.
On the Savoy label, the composition is credited not only to Silver, but to B. F. Wood.
Now the Kirby Band featured a composition called "Opus No. 5," but this is not the tune that resembles "Opus de Funk." That is something that comes from Chopin.
